info.title: ClangSharpPInvokeGenerator
info.description: ClangSharp are strongly-typed safe Clang bindings written in C# for .NET and Mono, tested on Linux and Windows.

options.name: --additional
options.description: An argument to pass to Clang when parsing the input files. []

options.name: --config
options.description: A configuration option that controls how the bindings are generated. Specify 'help' to see the available options. []

options.name: --generate
options.description: A feature to generate, e.g. 'aggressive-inlining', 'tests-nunit', or 'generated-code=type'. Append '=false' to opt a feature back out. Specify '--config help' to see the available names. []

options.name: --log
options.description: A diagnostic log to emit during generation: 'exclusions', 'potential-typedef-remappings', or 'visited-files'. []

options.name: --define-macro
options.description: Define <macro> to <value> (or 1 if <value> omitted). []

options.name: --exclude
options.description: A declaration name to exclude from binding generation. Supports `*` (any run) and `?` (single character) wildcards; exact matches take precedence. []

options.name: --file
options.description: A file to parse and generate bindings for. []

options.name: --file-directory
options.description: The base path for files to parse. []

options.name: --header-file
options.description: A file which contains the header to prefix every generated file with. []

options.name: --include
options.description: A declaration name to include in binding generation. Supports `*` (any run) and `?` (single character) wildcards; exact matches take precedence. []

options.name: --include-directory
options.description: Add directory to include search path. []

options.name: --language
options.description: Treat subsequent input files as having type <language>. [default: c++]

options.name: --library-path
options.description: The string to use in the DllImport attribute used when generating bindings. []

options.name: --method-class-name
options.description: The name of the static class that will contain the generated method bindings. [default: Methods]

options.name: --namespace
options.description: The namespace in which to place the generated bindings. []

options.name: --output-mode
options.description: The mode describing how the information collected from the headers are presented in the resultant bindings. [default: CSharp]

options.name: --output
options.description: The output location to write the generated bindings to. []

options.name: --prefix-strip
options.description: The prefix to strip from the generated method bindings. []

options.name: --type-prefix-strip
options.description: The prefix to strip from the generated enum, struct, and union type bindings (and their enum member names). []

options.name: --native-type-names-to-strip
options.description: The contents to strip from the generated NativeTypeName attributes. []

options.name: --remap
options.description: A declaration name to be remapped to another name during binding generation. []

options.name: --remap-type
options.description: A type (record or enum) declaration name to be remapped to another name during binding generation. Takes precedence over --remap and is useful when a type and field share a name. []

options.name: --remap-field
options.description: A field declaration name to be remapped to another name during binding generation. Takes precedence over --remap and is useful when a type and field share a name. []

options.name: --resource-directory
options.description: The Clang resource directory containing the builtin headers (such as stddef.h). When omitted, an installed and version-matched Clang's resource directory is automatically detected. []

options.name: --no-resource-directory-detection
options.description: Disable the automatic detection of the Clang resource directory.

options.name: --std
options.description: Language standard to compile for. []

options.name: --test-output
options.description: The output location to write the generated tests to. []

options.name: --traverse
options.description: A file name included either directly or indirectly by -f that should be traversed during binding generation. []

options.name: --version
options.description: Prints the current version information for the tool and its native dependencies.

options.name: --with-access-specifier
options.description: An access specifier to be used with the given qualified or remapped declaration name during binding generation. Supports `*` (any run) and `?` (single character) wildcards; exact matches take precedence. []

options.name: --with-attribute
options.description: An attribute to be added to the given remapped declaration name during binding generation. Supports `*` (any run) and `?` (single character) wildcards; exact matches take precedence. []

options.name: --with-base
options.description: An additional base type the generated type should derive from during binding generation. Applies to structs and COM interface types. Supports `*` (any run) and `?` (single character) wildcards; exact matches take precedence. []

options.name: --with-callconv
options.description: A calling convention to be used for the given declaration during binding generation. Supports `*` (any run) and `?` (single character) wildcards; exact matches take precedence. []

options.name: --with-class
options.description: A class to be used for the given remapped constant or function declaration name during binding generation. Supports a trailing `*` wildcard for prefix matching; an exact match takes precedence. []

options.name: --with-conditional
options.description: A preprocessor symbol used to wrap single-file C# output in a leading '#if <symbol>' and trailing '#endif'. Useful when files can't be conditionally excluded at the project level (e.g. Unity). []

options.name: --with-constant-folded-value
options.description: Emit the clang-evaluated constant value for the given declaration instead of translating the written initializer expression. Useful when an initializer references companion declarations that aren't themselves generated. Applies to enum members (matched by the qualified `Enum.Member`, so `Enum.*` folds every member) and to macro or const value declarations. Supports `*` (any run) and `?` (single character) wildcards; exact matches take precedence. []

options.name: --with-enum-member-strip
options.description: How to strip a prefix or suffix from the members of the given remapped enum name during binding generation. Mode is one of `none`, `common-prefix`, `common-suffix`, `type-name`, `prefix:<str>`, or `suffix:<str>`. Supports `*` (any run) and `?` (single character) wildcards; exact matches take precedence. []

options.name: --with-equality-members
options.description: Generate IEquatable<T> with field-wise Equals, GetHashCode, and the == and != operators for the given struct. Opt-in and not valid for every native type; a named struct also opts in the nested and base structs it compares. Supports `*` (any run) and `?` (single character) wildcards; exact matches take precedence. []

options.name: --with-guid
options.description: A GUID to be used for the given declaration during binding generation. Supports `*` (any run) and `?` (single character) wildcards; exact matches take precedence. []

options.name: --with-length
options.description: A length to be used for the given declaration during binding generation. Supports `*` (any run) and `?` (single character) wildcards; exact matches take precedence. []

options.name: --with-library-path
options.description: A library path to be used for the given declaration during binding generation. Supports `*` (any run) and `?` (single character) wildcards; exact matches take precedence. []

options.name: --with-manual-import
options.description: A remapped function name to be treated as a manual import during binding generation. Supports `*` (any run) and `?` (single character) wildcards; exact matches take precedence. []

options.name: --with-namespace
options.description: A namespace to be used for the given remapped declaration name during binding generation. Supports a trailing `*` wildcard for prefix matching; an exact match takes precedence. []

options.name: --with-packing
options.description: Overrides the StructLayoutAttribute.Pack property for the given type. Supports `*` (any run) and `?` (single character) wildcards; exact matches take precedence. []

options.name: --with-readonly
options.description: Add the readonly modifier to a given instance method. Supports `*` (any run) and `?` (single character) wildcards; exact matches take precedence. []

options.name: --with-setlasterror
options.description: Add the SetLastError=true modifier or SetsSystemLastError attribute to a given DllImport or UnmanagedFunctionPointer. Supports `*` (any run) and `?` (single character) wildcards; exact matches take precedence. []

options.name: --with-suppressgctransition
options.description: Add the SuppressGCTransition calling convention to a given DllImport or UnmanagedFunctionPointer. Supports `*` (any run) and `?` (single character) wildcards; exact matches take precedence. []

options.name: --with-transparent-struct
options.description: A remapped type name to be treated as a transparent wrapper during binding generation. Matched by exact name only. []

options.name: --with-type
options.description: A type to be used for the given enum declaration, macro constant, or struct field (using the qualified `Type.field`) during binding generation. Supports `*` (any run) and `?` (single character) wildcards; exact matches take precedence. []

options.name: --with-using
options.description: A using directive to be included for the given remapped declaration name during binding generation. Supports `*` (any run) and `?` (single character) wildcards; exact matches take precedence. []

options.name: --without-access-specifier
options.description: A declaration name to opt back out of a '--with-access-specifier *' catch-all. []

options.name: --without-attribute
options.description: A declaration name to opt back out of a '--with-attribute *' catch-all. []

options.name: --without-callconv
options.description: A declaration name to opt back out of a '--with-callconv *' catch-all. []

options.name: --without-constant-folded-value
options.description: A declaration name to opt back out of a '--with-constant-folded-value *' catch-all. []

options.name: --without-enum-member-strip
options.description: An enum name to opt back out of a '--with-enum-member-strip *' catch-all. []

options.name: --without-equality-members
options.description: A struct name to opt back out of a '--with-equality-members *' catch-all. []

options.name: --without-library-path
options.description: A declaration name to opt back out of a '--with-library-path *' catch-all. []

options.name: --without-readonly
options.description: A method name to opt back out of a '--with-readonly *' catch-all. []

options.name: --without-setlasterror
options.description: A declaration name to opt back out of a '--with-setlasterror *' catch-all. []

options.name: --without-suppressgctransition
options.description: A declaration name to opt back out of a '--with-suppressgctransition *' catch-all. []

options.name: --without-type
options.description: A declaration name to opt back out of a '--with-type *' catch-all. []

options.name: --without-using
options.description: A declaration name to opt back out of a '--with-using *' catch-all. []

options.name: --help
options.description: Show help and usage information
